beats.summary: Michael and the office team set up a fake company and surveillance to spy on Danny's sales technique.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I owe you…a most sincere and humble apology. We were trying to watch you to see your sales technique
Michael: Yes. And it's the sincerest form of flattery.

beats.summary: Danny discovers the deception and confronts Michael about the fake company and hired actors.

evidence.snippet: Danny: Okay, so you…set up this fake company, then you hired this homeless woman to impersonate an executive to spy on me

beats.summary: Michael offers Danny a job at Dunder-Mifflin, trying to convince him to join by promising more money and freedom.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I can give you more money-there's your better life. I can let you come and go as you please-there's your freedom.

beats.summary: Jim and Dwight coach Oscar and Ryan to impersonate executives to help get Meredith out of the fake company setup.

evidence.snippet: Jim: So you're taking over. You just gotta get her out of there as soon as you can.
Dwight: Okay. You're a young hotshot from Stark Industries. You've just bought this company.
